description: This file defines the interface for the Http2Adapter class, which processes HTTP/2 frames and manages communication with a visitor interface. It includes method declarations for handling HTTP/2 operations such as settings, priority, ping, shutdown, flow control, and stream management.

classes.name: Http2Adapter
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides an interface for processing HTTP/2 frames, managing flow control, and communicating with a visitor interface.

methods.name: IsServerSession
methods.description: Returns whether the session is a server-side session.

methods.name: want_read
methods.description: Indicates if the adapter wants to read data.

methods.name: want_write
methods.description: Indicates if the adapter wants to write data.

methods.name: ProcessBytes
methods.description: Processes incoming bytes as HTTP/2 frames and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: SubmitSettings
methods.description: Submits HTTP/2 settings to the peer.

methods.name: SubmitPriorityForStream
methods.description: Submits a PRIORITY frame for a specific stream.

methods.name: SubmitPing
methods.description: Submits a PING frame.

methods.name: SubmitShutdownNotice
methods.description: Starts a graceful shutdown; no-op for clients.

methods.name: SubmitGoAway
methods.description: Submits a GOAWAY frame indicating connection shutdown.

methods.name: SubmitWindowUpdate
methods.description: Submits a WINDOW_UPDATE for a stream or connection.

methods.name: SubmitRst
methods.description: Resets a stream with an error code.

methods.name: SubmitMetadata
methods.description: Submits metadata frames for a stream.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Invokes visitor callback to send serialized frames.

methods.name: GetSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns connection-level flow control window size.

methods.name: GetStreamSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns stream-level flow control window size.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowLimit
methods.description: Returns upper bound on receive window for a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns current receive window size for a stream.

methods.name: GetReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns total connection receive window size.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns HPACK encoder's dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns HPACK decoder's dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHighestReceivedStreamId
methods.description: Returns highest stream ID received; valid for server endpoints.

methods.name: MarkDataConsumedForStream
methods.description: Marks data as consumed for flow control updates.

methods.name: SubmitRequest
methods.description: Submits an HTTP/2 request with headers and optional body.

methods.name: SubmitResponse
methods.description: Submits an HTTP/2 response with headers and optional body.

methods.name: SubmitTrailer
methods.description: Queues trailers to be sent after stream data.

methods.name: SetStreamUserData
methods.description: Associates user data with a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a stream.

methods.name: ResumeStream
methods.description: Resumes a previously blocked stream.
